verdict.rationale: Persona is an identity-verification SaaS, so an official CLI is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence covers the REST API, SDKs, webhooks, sandbox and an llms.txt page for agents, but no item mentions an official command-line tool. An llms.txt file and API access are adjacent developer building blocks, not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
